title: IntLawNER: A Named Entity Recognition Dataset and Benchmark in International Law
abstract: arXiv:2609.22529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: International law provides the normative framework through which states coordinate action, regulate armed conflict, and protect human rights, yet its texts remain without token-level named entity recognition (NER) resources. We introduce IntLawNER, a NER dataset and benchmark for codified sources of international law, covering 2,987 gold-annotated sentences and 8,094 entity spans from International Court of Justice (ICJ) decisions, UN Security Council resolutions, and European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) judgments, annotated with seven institution-specific entity types. We construct IntLawNER with a cost-effective hybrid algorithmic-agentic pipeline that reduces 468k source sentences to a compact annotation set through candidate retrieval, LLM-based vetting, and human review, with 89.6% of gold spans accepted unchanged from the silver layer. translated_title: IntLawNER：国际法领域的命名实体识别数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 国际法为国家间协调行动、规范武装冲突和保护人权提供了规范性框架，然而其文本至今仍缺乏词元级命名实体识别（NER）资源。我们提出了IntLawNER，这是一个面向国际法成文法源的NER数据集与基准，涵盖来自国际法院（ICJ）判决、联合国安理会决议和欧洲人权法院（ECtHR）判决的2,987个金标准标注句子和8,094个实体跨度，并标注了七种机构特定的实体类型。我们通过一种高性价比的算法-智能体混合流水线构建了IntLawNER，该流水线通过候选检索、基于大语言模型的筛选和人工审核，将46.8万条源句子缩减为紧凑的标注集，其中89.6%的金标准跨度直接从银层未经修改地被采纳。然而，从银层到金层的分析表明，人机总体一致性指标……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了首个国际法领域的命名实体识别数据集与基准IntLawNER，包含来自国际法院、联合国安理会和欧洲人权法院文本的2,987个金标准句子和8,094个实体跨度，并通过低成本的人机混合流水线高效构建而成。
en_tdlr: Introduces IntLawNER, the first NER dataset and benchmark for international law, comprising 2,987 gold-annotated sentences and 8,094 entity spans from ICJ, UN Security Council, and ECtHR texts, built through a cost-effective hybrid algorithmic-agentic pipeline.
